invites_redemption_check.name: invites_redemption_check
invites_redemption_check.value: ("invites"."redeemed_at" IS NULL AND "invites"."redeemed_by" IS NULL) OR ("invites"."redeemed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "invites"."redeemed_at" >= "invites"."created_at" AND "invites"."redeemed_at" < "invites"."expires_at" AND "invites"."revoked_at" IS NULL)

jobs_lock_check.name: jobs_lock_check
jobs_lock_check.value: ("jobs"."state" = 'running' AND "jobs"."locked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "jobs"."locked_by" IS NOT NULL AND "jobs"."attempts" > 0) OR ("jobs"."state" <> 'running' AND "jobs"."locked_at" IS NULL AND "jobs"."locked_by" IS NULL)

media_dimensions_check.name: media_dimensions_check
media_dimensions_check.value: ("media"."width" IS NULL OR "media"."width" > 0) AND ("media"."height" IS NULL OR "media"."height" > 0) AND ("media"."duration_ms" IS NULL OR "media"."duration_ms" > 0)

media_ready_check.name: media_ready_check
media_ready_check.value: "media"."state" <> 'ready' OR ("media"."actual_bytes" IS NOT NULL AND "media"."actual_bytes" > 0 AND "media"."content_type" IS NOT NULL AND (("media"."kind" = 'image' AND "media"."content_type" IN ('image/jpeg','image/png','image/webp') AND "media"."width" IS NOT NULL AND "media"."height" IS NOT NULL) OR ("media"."kind" = 'audio' AND "media"."content_type" = 'audio/mpeg' AND "media"."duration_ms" IS NOT NULL)))

draft_document_check.name: draft_document_check
draft_document_check.value: jsonb_typeof("profile_drafts"."document") = 'object' AND ("profile_drafts"."document"->'schemaVersion') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb("profile_drafts"."schema_version")

username_retirement_check.name: username_retirement_check
username_retirement_check.value: ("username_claims"."owner_id" IS NOT NULL AND "username_claims"."retired_at" IS NULL) OR ("username_claims"."owner_id" IS NULL AND "username_claims"."retired_at" IS NOT NULL)

media_storage_bytes.name: media_storage_bytes
media_storage_bytes.value: "media_storage"."charged_bytes" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991 AND "media_storage"."private_bytes" >= 0 AND "media_storage"."public_budget_bytes" >= 0 AND "media_storage"."received_bytes" >= 0 AND "media_storage"."charged_bytes" >= "media_storage"."private_bytes" + "media_storage"."public_budget_bytes"
